style: Avant-garde vocal-group pop meets garage-band doo-wop and theatrical cabaret. [HARMONY SYSTEM] Quartal voicing and suspended fields with microtonal pure intervals rubbing against barbershop-style voice leading and ringing dominant tension. [MELODIC SYSTEM] Fast scat-like contour with clipped consonant attacks alternating with long, winding melismatic arcs ignoring bar lines. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] Swinging triplet subdivision under straight modal drone pulses, with additive Balkan asymmetric meters and abrupt stop-start punk silences. [TIMBRE / ATMOSPHERE SYSTEM] Upright bass, brushed percussion, tack piano, spring-reverb surf guitar stabs, and handclaps recorded with 1960s mono dry room capture. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] Theatrical overstatement played with deadpan urgency, nervous high-altitude energy, and cocky club swagger. [ANCHOR] A repeated acapella vocal drone that anchors every sonic mutation.
